result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and both dispatch to the same code. I haven't run the program: the `java` runs were denied approval, so the help output and the `index.html` creation are unverified. The `cli` module compiles offline (`mvn -q -o -pl cli compile`), and I didn't run any tests.

Changes:
- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description (the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, the same as `updateLandscape`). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`, which stays.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: the existing `updateLandscape` dispatch branch now also matches `analyzeLandscape`, so options and behaviour are shared. For `-help`, the usage now uses the name the user typed, and `analyzeLandscape -help` prints its own description. `updateLandscape -help` prints the same text as before.
- **`README.md`**: it had no per-command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape" section covering both names and the shared options.
